name: Reedel
description: A student-centric social media website with posts, messaging, study rooms and tiktok like scrolling but for questions instead of videos.

name: Blur
description: An app for anonymous/non-anonymous confessions, vents, rants, gossips and more in school or public circles!

name: BookBukkit
description: A simple, offline mobile app to track books you've read, are currently reading, or want to read..

name: Hackabile
description: Mobile implementation of Hackatime, using Dart+Flutter and the public Hackatime API.

name: QuizQuest
description: An app which uses generative AI to generate a multiple-choice quiz on any specified topic.

name: Skyward Madness
description: A physics-based vertical city construction simulator developed during a 48-hour game jam. Players must manage structural load across stacked building modules, where improper placement may result in full structural collapse.

name: Guiding Light
description: A game where you place lights with different intensities. There is a moth that is attracted to light, which you have to guide through the lights to the literal window to the next level.
